capabilities: Show tag descriptions as hover tooltips in Reading view and Live Preview
Set or edit descriptions from the editor context menu
List tags without descriptions ranked by usage
Inherit parent descriptions for nested tags
Export and import descriptions to JSON for moving between vaults
extras: Pending review in the community plugin directory, so it must be installed via BRAT or manually. Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later; tooltips do not work on touch devices or in pop-out windows. Descriptions are plain text capped at 100 characters and tag matching is case-sensitive by design.
problem: Obsidian tags carry no explanation of what they mean, so users forget their own conventions as a vault grows.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin and enable it.

summary: Tag annotation tool that adds custom definitions to tags and shows them as hover tooltips wherever a tag appears.
